title: India Hosts 13th ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement Joint Committee Meeting to Advance ASEAN-India Trade Pact Review
description: India hosted the 13th AITIGA Joint Committee meeting to advance the review of the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement, aiming to strengthen market access, trade facilitation and economic cooperation as bilateral trade reached Rs. 11,31,136 crore (US$ 128 billion) in 2025-26.
